groups.title: Corner notchers · value line
groups.lead: Hydraulic, pneumatic and manual corner notchers — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: NovoTech's value-line notchers, built in China, add the HNM-6 and HNM-6A hydraulic notchers for 1/4″, PNM pneumatic notchers and HN hand and FN foot notchers for 16 ga to 1/8″.
points_add: NovoTech value line: HNM-6 / HNM-6A hydraulic 1/4″, PNM-130 / 150 pneumatic, HN hand and FN foot notchers

faq_add.a: A hydraulic notcher cuts 3/16 – 1/4″ plate quickly and is the choice for a production shop or for heavier plate; a pneumatic notcher runs on shop air and cuts up to 1/8″ in sheet — quieter, no hydraulic oil, a lower price; a hand or foot notcher does 16 ga to 1/8″ without power for the shop that notches now and then. The premium-line HNM notchers and the value-line HNM-6 / HNM-6A differ in build and price; both have adjustable stops and a sheet hold-down.

set.hero_brand_line: Premium-line corner notchers are built in Turkey to NovoTech's specification with European hydraulic and electrical components; the value-line notchers are built in China to NovoTech's specification. All sold with a 1-year warranty and supported from Mississauga, ON, Canada.
